feeds.title: I am an Educator
feeds.description: I AM AN EDUCATOR is a new website dedicated to defending the humanity of the educator and a vision of education that contributes to creating a socially just society. Its blog features content on black lives matter, black movements, the latest news, and more.

feeds.title: Tanesha B. Forman Blog
feeds.description: The personal educational blog is empowering educators to reimagine learning spaces that center equity and anti-racism by interrogating mindsets, practices, and systems. The Tanesha B. Forman Blog covers some interesting topics like self-awareness, alternatives to suspension, misconceptions about suspensions, black history, and more.

feeds.title: Black Education Matters
feeds.description: The Black Education Matters Student Activist Award gives recognition, support, and a $1,000 award to student leaders in the Seattle Public Schools who demonstrate exceptional leadership in struggles against racism. The education blog features the latest award winners and information about the organization's activities.

feeds.title: Tales of Patty Pepper Blog
feeds.description: Follow the Tales of Patty Pepper Blog to read articles such as 3 LOW PREP ACTIVITIES CELEBRATING DR. KING, 6 Easy Steps to An Organized Classroom, Build Student Relationships in the New Year, 4 Ways to Ring in The New Year With Your Students. The blog is run by women who helps elementary teachers and schools find creative ways to enhance their classroom school lessons by providing classroom tech tips, classroom organization skills, incorporating social-emotional lessons and reading resources

feeds.title: Mrs. Russell's Room
feeds.description: Mrs. Russell is a third-grade teacher to eleven wonderful boys in a public school here in Central Florida. When she is not teaching, she prefers to travel often to train other teachers. She is passionate about teaching for high engagement, using standards-based teaching and rubrics to improve growth, and teaching writing. Follow her blog to learn more about her daily activities, informative articles, tips, and teaching advices.

feeds.title: Black Educators Alliance Blog
feeds.description: BEA is a self-organized network of 'Black' educators committed to radically transforming structures and institutions that impact upon the equitable experiences, achievement opportunities, and outcomes for Black educators, parents, families, and students, and our wider education community. The education blog features articles on schools, teachers, exams, inspiring stories.

feeds.title: The Tutu Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Tu Tu teacher is a personal educational blog managed by Vera. She is an educational presenter, consultant, and kindergarten teacher. Her blog features topics like education, school, children's activities, black Lives Matter, books, and more.

feeds.title: BMEs Talk Blog
feeds.description: They are a professional learning community and leadership development tool that motivates all black male students. Their Vision is To inspire Black Male Educators (BMEs) to achieve their full potential. They want to create and curate safe, rich spaces for Black Male Educators (BMEs) to connect, grow and lead. Read their latest blogs to learn about topics like black students, black educators, equity in education, and leadership development.

feeds.title: Mr Elementary Math Blog
feeds.description: If you are searching for math ideas for your elementary, then you're in the right spot! Follow the Mr. Elementary Math Blog for guided math, best teaching practices, engaging math activities, and more.

feeds.title: Melissa Nikohl Blog
feeds.description: Melissa Nikohl helps you find your dream teaching job and to help you push your kiddos to their full potential. Every educator wants to grow and be stronger. You already have the basics down and now it's time to level up! She will teach you some secrets in education. Follow her blog for more information on topics like resuming writing, jobs for teachers, educational companies, the best coffee shops for working and studying in Dallas.

feeds.title: Center For Black Educator Development Blog
feeds.description: They aspire to lift up Black students by significantly growing the number of highly effective Black and fellow educators who appreciate the power of culture and have elected to fight for social justice in classrooms through revolutionary education. The center's blog is about personal stories, education, schools, podcasts, black teachers and more.

feeds.title: Education With An Apron Blog
feeds.description: The author helps primary educators make ALL subjects globally relevant, authentic, and FUN so that students grow to be independent workers and critical thinkers. If you need ideas, resources, or a community of teachers who truly believe that their students will change the world then follow their blog for more information.
